Amazing food at great prices.
Aug 2026 • Family
Having visited cheers last year we popped back in Monday night for a visit. As usual staff were so friendly and attentive, the service is amazing and the food was delicious, very generous portions. Having been in Vietnam for 3 weeks we wanted some good old English food for a change. We had the lasagna, 2 cottage pies & a hunters chicken. All so fresh and tasty. Ice cold beers and excellent value for money. We will definitely be back next year for our 3rd visit. Wonderful place that’s run very well. Thank you to all the staff.

Fantastic find
Dec 2025 • Friends
Absolutely brilliant spot! 🍺

The English Sports Bar in Nha Trang is a must-visit for anyone craving proper English comfort food done right. The food is outstanding—classic British dishes cooked to perfection and full of flavor, just like you’d hope for from a true English pub.
The staff are incredibly friendly and welcoming, creating a relaxed, upbeat atmosphere that makes you want to stay longer than planned. Whether you’re popping in for a meal or settling in to watch sports, you’re made to feel right at home.

There’s also an excellent selection of drinks, including a solid range of British beers, which really completes the authentic pub experience. Add in the lively sports-bar vibe, and you’ve got one of the best places in Nha Trang to eat, relax, and enjoy great company.

Highly recommended—this place truly delivers on quality, atmosphere, and hospitality 🇬🇧✨

Met some great people here too — that’s part of what makes this place special. The English Sports Bar has such a friendly, social vibe that it’s easy to strike up conversations and feel like part of the crowd. Whether you’re a local or just passing through Nha Trang, it’s one of those rare places where good food, good drinks, and genuinely good people all come together. 🍻

Western food!
Mar 2024 • Couples
We felt like “western” food and found this for lunch. The menu is quite large for offering British food. There is a Sunday Roast option as well which I saw a man eating and it was a nice large portion. 
We ordered the Chicken Schnitzel and a bacon cheeseburger. Both came with chips. We also ordered a beer and the total cost was approx $24 CAD. It was delicious and large portions.
This place offers live music sometimes as well as English speaking TV channels for sports and F1. 
The ladies who worked here the day I visited all speak good English if that’s at all a concern for western travelers. 
They also offer a good English breakfast as well! Would highly recommend.
